# De Studio Home

> > De Studio Home is a sustainable kitchenware and premium home décor retailer specializing in eco-friendly, designer products from Casa Bugatti, Anna Cavalli, and other curated international brands.

Founded by Joachim de Souza, De Studio Home curates a carefully selected collection of sustainable kitchenware, drinkware, tableware, and home décor items sourced from premium European and international brands. The store emphasizes quality, sustainability, and design excellence across all product categories.

## Key Topics

- Casa Bugatti
- BUGATTI
- Anna Cavalli
- Sustainable kitchenware
- Eco-friendly home décor
- Drinkware

## Core Collections

- [All Products](https://destudiohome.com/collections/all): Complete product catalog featuring Casa Bugatti, Anna Cavalli, and AMT collections
- [Dining Accessories](https://destudiohome.com/collections/dining-accessories): Dining accessories collection including Casa Bugatti and Anna Cavalli tableware
- [Drinkware](https://destudiohome.com/collections/drinkware): Drinkware collection with BUGATTI, Casa Bugatti, and Anna Cavalli brands
- [Kitchenware](https://destudiohome.com/collections/kitchenware): Kitchenware collection featuring BUGATTI and Kyocera ceramic knife sets

## Beverage & Accessories

- [Coffee Accessories](https://destudiohome.com/collections/coffee-accessories): Coffee accessories including BUGATTI Jackie electric kettle and drinkware
- [Tea Accessories](https://destudiohome.com/collections/tea-accessories): Tea accessories featuring Casa Bugatti and Jackie electric kettle products
- [Stainless Steel Water Bottles](https://destudiohome.com/collections/stainless-steel-water-bottles): Stainless steel water bottles including Casa Bugatti La Ville collection
- [Drinkware Accessories](https://destudiohome.com/collections/drinkware-accessories): Drinkware accessories including drinking glasses and juice dispensers
- [Bottle Accessories](https://destudiohome.com/collections/bottle-accessories): Bottle accessories including BUGATTI INFINITY bottle openers and kitchen gadgets

## Kitchen & Cutlery

- [Kitchen Knives & Knife Sets](https://destudiohome.com/collections/knives-kitchen): Kitchen knives and sets from KYOCERA and BUGATTI eco-friendly collections
- [Cutlery Sets](https://destudiohome.com/collections/cutlery-sets): Stainless steel cutlery sets from Casa Bugatti METROPOLIS and SIENA lines
- [Olive Wooden Gadgets](https://destudiohome.com/collections/olive-wooden-gadgets): Olive wood kitchen gadgets and serving items from multiple premium brands

## Home Décor & Lifestyle

- [Home Decor](https://destudiohome.com/collections/home-decor): Home décor collection with plantable pens and cushion covers from premium brands
- [Candles](https://destudiohome.com/collections/candles): Soy wax scented candles including Mr. Darcy's Library fragrance collection
- [Organic](https://destudiohome.com/collections/organic): Organic collection featuring mulberry silk and organic wool bedding products
